"### SAMURAI – Six Elements

Game Concept @COMMENT_BODY@ Design Script

Genre: 2D Side-Scrolling Action / Hack and Slash / Wave-Based Boss Rush

Art Style: Detailed 2D artwork inspired by Dead Cells, set in a fictional Japanese samurai era. The world combines traditional Japanese architecture, samurai culture, supernatural creatures, mythical weapons, and fantasy armor.

### 1\. Element Selection

At the beginning of the game, the player chooses one of six elements. Each element has unique attacks, abilities, and combat styles.

* Fire: High damage, explosions, and burning attacks.

* Water: Fluid attacks, healing, and defensive abilities.

* Wind: Fast attacks, aerial movement, and tornadoes.

* Earth: Heavy attacks, armor, and ground manipulation.

* Light: Precision, critical hits, and blinding attacks.

* Darkness: Shadow clones, teleportation, and curses.

### 2\. Combat System

The game uses classic 2D side-scrolling combat.

* Light and heavy katana attacks.

* Elemental special attacks.

* Dodging and parrying.

* Combos and finishing moves.

* One powerful elemental ultimate.

### 3\. Wave System

Each stage consists of several enemy waves followed by one final boss.

| Wave  | Enemies                  |
| ----- | ------------------------ |
| 1     | 2 basic samurai          |
| 2     | 3 samurai                |
| 3     | 3–4 supernatural enemies |
| 4     | 4–5 elite warriors       |
| 5     | 1 powerful mini-boss     |
| Final | 1 unique stage boss      |

### 4\. Enemy Designs

All enemies are designed around the samurai era, with fictional additions.

* Samurai Soldiers: Basic katana and spear fighters.

* Cursed Ronin: Corrupted swordsmen with supernatural abilities.

* Oni Warriors: Giant demonic samurai with heavy weapons.

* Phantom Archers: Ghostly ranged attackers.

* Elite Samurai: Highly skilled warriors with unique techniques.

### 5\. Bosses

Every stage ends with a unique boss featuring multiple combat phases, special attacks, and a distinctive design.

Examples:

* Crimson Shogun: Fire-based warrior.

* Drowned General: Water-based warrior.

* Hollow Monk: Illusion and shadow master.

* Mountain Oni: Giant earth warrior.

* Celestial Executioner: Light-based swordsman.

* Shadow Shogun: Darkness-based final boss.

### 6\. Progression System

Defeating enemies and bosses rewards the player with:

* New katanas and weapons.

* Samurai armor and masks.

* Elemental upgrades.

* New combat techniques.

* Stronger ultimate abilities.

### 7\. Overall Vision

A Dead Cells-inspired 2D samurai action game where players choose one of six elements, fight increasingly difficult groups of supernatural samurai, and face a powerful boss at the end of every stage.

The main focus is fast-paced combat, unique enemy designs, challenging boss battles, and six distinct elemental playstyles.
"
